name: iwac-search-client
description: Svelte client for the IwacSearch Omeka S module — public discovery surface backed by Typesense.

scripts.build: npm run lint:theme && npm run lint:drift && npm run lint:i18n && npm run build:public && npm run build:header
scripts.lint: npm run lint:theme && npm run lint:drift && npm run lint:i18n && eslint src/svelte src/svelte-shared scripts tests && prettier --check "src/svelte/**/*.{ts,svelte}" "src/svelte-shared/**/*.{ts,svelte}" "scripts/**/*.js" "tests/client/**/*.ts" "*.{ts,json,md}"
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src/svelte src/svelte-shared scripts tests --fix && prettier --write "src/svelte/**/*.{ts,svelte}" "src/svelte-shared/**/*.{ts,svelte}" "scripts/**/*.js" "tests/client/**/*.ts" "*.{ts,json,md}"
